sections.content: Use gustar, preferir, encantar and parecer to express reactions to cultural works. Opinion phrases such as *creo* *que*, me parece que and *para* mí allow you to distinguish a personal response from a neutral description.

items.spanish: Prefiero las novelas porque puedo imaginar mejor a los personajes.
items.english: I prefer novels because I can imagine the characters better.

items.spanish: Me encanta esta película por su argumento.
items.english: I love this film because of its plot.

items.spanish: Creo que la canción tiene una interpretación excelente.
items.english: I think the song has an excellent performance.

items.spanish: Para mí, esta obra es más interesante que la anterior.
items.english: For me, this work is more interesting than the previous one.

sections.content: State the preference first, then give a reason to make the opinion more useful.
